issues.where: crop L, white polar cap near the upper limb
issues.what: The cap resolves into tightly coiled white contour lines with a hard, nearly blown-out edge. It reads as a pinched decal rather than textured ice.
issues.fix: Reproject the polar texture without a singularity, break up the concentric lines with irregular ice detail, and recover tonal variation inside the cap.

issues.where: crop Q, raised fan and central canyon walls
issues.what: The fan forms a cluster of extruded spikes, while the adjacent walls show parallel dark grooves and bright rims that make the terrain look embossed.
issues.fix: Reduce the relief and rim contrast, break up the parallel grooves, and use finer irregular erosion detail at the fan and wall transitions.

issues.where: crops A and B, dust spiral and illuminated upper-left limb
issues.what: The spiral has broad, soft brushlike streaks, and the adjacent limb washes the ground into a smooth peach band. The loss of fine detail is conspicuous next to the sharp crater and canyon rims.
issues.fix: Add fine, irregular dust structure and make the optical thickness vary so ground texture fades progressively toward the limb.

issues.where: crop G, foreground moon crown and large right-hand crater
issues.what: Rock texture drags into smooth parallel streaks across the lit crown, and the crater's bright interior has a crisp cutout edge against the shadow.
issues.fix: Remove directional stretching from the rock texture and use irregular rim geometry and subtle indirect light to break up the crater shadow edge.
